title: WP-P0…WP-P3 of the Portal build pack: gov.br federation via Cognito (ADR-0024), portal data model (five BP-PORTAL blueprints, DDL 61–65 + handwritten 19/14/11, canonical fixtures), citizen identity guard and act-level matrix as data, citizen routes /v1/portal/* (identity, requests with immediate protocol and delegation port, inbox/SNE, ombudsman, projections, cached national reads, SSE), PORTAL_RULES policy, command contracts and typed clients

batches.headline: Delivered ADR-0024, contract CTG-0001 (52 criteria), five BP-PORTAL blueprints with operations: [] and generated packages/DDL 61–65, handwritten DDL 19 (platform, RLS-exempt by design), 14 (portal timers) and 11 (portal schema triggers), seed 70, @detran/portal-identity (PortalCitizenGuard fail-closed, PortalIdentityService with assertActLevel/assertEntitled, GET me/brand/services), Host tenant resolution, AppModule wiring, RLS allowlist; tests unit/integration/e2e (PR #54).

Delivered contract CTG-0002 (43 routes, 84 criteria) and M24 wiring, PORTAL_RULES (29 keys; portal:appeal:* removed), identity routes §3, request lifecycle §5 with immediate protocol, delegation port (UnavailableDelegationTarget until R-0007) and idempotency 409, inbox with SNE acknowledgement evidence and NOTIFICACAO_CIENCIA, SNE enrolment, ombudsman manifestations/evaluations with T-OUV-* from DDL 14, five projections with replay, cached national reads through the senatran-adapter ports, GET /v1/portal/stream, five command contracts (47 operations) with typed clients, request-draft schema, documentation transcription and OD-P14…P46 (PR #56).
